entities.name: Rock of the Fighting Man
entities.summary: Smooth, shining black cliff face carved with a warrior about sixty feet high in ancient mail and helm, sword in right hand, stern of face.

refs.q: on this smooth space was carven in the living rock the image of a warrior in mail and helm of ancient fashion, and holding a sword in his right hand

entities.name: (unnamed) pass of the Fighting Man
entities.summary: Very narrow pass through the mountains, twilit, a strip of stars overhead.

refs.q: the rocks of the pass closed about them, leaving but a way so narrow that they could see a glimmer of the stars above them

spatial.terrain_text: bight between the ness and the main wall

refs.q: there they stood in an awful bight of the mountain, made by that ness, and the main wall from which it thrust out

spatial.travel_time_text: noon of the third day after leaving the rock-sea (one rest day)

refs.q: it was not till noon of the third day from the rock-sea that they came to the very feet of that fire-scorched ness

spatial.note: the road begins at the carving

refs.q: In a little while the rocks of the pass closed about them
naught save a tumble of rocks that had fallen from the cliffs, piled up strangely, and making a maze through which the Sage led them surely
the twain mounted their horses again and set forth silently on the road

facts.subject: Rock of the Fighting Man
facts.statement: The carving is about sixty feet tall in very hard rock, clean and clear.

refs.q: From head to heel he seemed some sixty feet high, and the rock was so hard, that he was all clean and clear to see

facts.subject: (unnamed) pass of the Fighting Man
facts.statement: Light in the pass is little better than twilight at best.

refs.q: such daylight as the mountain pass will give you, which at the best is little better than twilight

events.label: Parting from the Sage at the Gate
events.summary: The Sage brings them to the Fighting Man and leaves; they enter the pass.

refs.q: he drew himself away from them, and turned about with no word more, and went his ways

opportunities.idea: Gigantic ancient carvings as world-gate landmarks (fixed placement relative to the lava field and mountain ness).

basis_refs.q: the image of a warrior in mail and helm of ancient fashion

ledger.summary: After a rest day of revision, they cross the plain; at noon on the third day from the rock-sea they reach the foot of the fire-scorched ness. There are no foothills, only a maze of fallen rocks. Rounding the ness, they see on a smooth black cliff a carved warrior about sixty feet tall in ancient mail and helm, holding a sword, with a stern face: the Rock of the Fighting Man. The Sage leaves them there without farewell. They ride into a very narrow pass, twilight by day, like an endless prison, and shelter in a rock cleft. Ralph sinks into dread until Ursula draws him out by asking about Upmeads.
ledger.geography_notes: The plain before the mountains ends with no foothills, only a tumbled maze of fallen rock. The ness rises sheer and overhanging. In a bight between the ness and the main wall, a smooth black cliff bears the carved Fighting Man. The pass beyond is a narrow cleft showing only a strip of sky.
